name: Summit AZ - Utah Organic Snapshot 2026-09-16
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-16

> **This note is about the UTAH site (summitplumbingut.com), not Arizona.** It is filed here because the file sits in the Arizona folder. Never combine these numbers with Arizona data. The Utah site is a separate client property, out of scope unless Kim asks.

# Summary
Utah organic SEO snapshot (v2), read-only, Sep 16, 2026, using the GSC web UI for property https://summitplumbingut.com/ (Utah County and Salt Lake County). It mirrors the Arizona snapshot format.

# Key numbers (L30 vs P30)
- 63 clicks (+23.5%), 25,143 impressions (+81%), position 8.5 vs 13.8. About 16,600 impressions were classed as suspected automated (non-brand queries at position 3 or better with 0 clicks, 92% desktop); an inference, not confirmed.
- Brand clicks 30; non-brand clicks 5.
- GA4 529636373 was contaminated by Arizona hits Sep 3 to 12. TAG CRM held 0 Utah-area-code leads (Utah leads do not seem to flow into that CRM record). GBP and call data unavailable.

# Indexing and pages
- Indexed only 26; not indexed 109 (69 crawled not indexed, 22 404s).
- The homepage carries most impressions; a Vineyard general plumbing page drew 816 impressions from one query.
- Live crawl: 91 sitemap URLs, 35 cities x 2 services, no Arizona content.

# Top issues
1. Only 26 pages indexed; 69 crawled not indexed, 22 404s.
2. 288 of 420 nearby-city links on drain pages return 404, plus broken contact and water heater buttons.
3. City page duplication (South Jordan vs West Jordan 93%) and wrong-city lines.
4. /pricing/ and /terms-and-conditions/ indexable lorem ipsum.
5. /utah-county/ (21 words) ranks for "plumber utah county".
